label: Formulated the Impartial Spectator as the foundation of conscience and objective moral judgment
Systematized the division of labor as the primary catalyst of productivity and national wealth
Introduced the invisible hand to theorize spontaneous market order and decentralized resource coordination
Smith's Theory of Moral Sentiments and impartial spectator directly influenced Kant's moral philosophy and formulations of conscience
Hegel drew upon Smith's political economy to construct his concept of civil society (bürgerliche Gesellschaft) and the system of needs
Marx studied Smith's political economy intensively, developing Smith's labor theory while critiquing capitalist exploitation and class antagonism
Mill systematized and expanded Smith's classical economic framework, integrating competitive market dynamics with utilitarian liberalism
